scripts.test: npm run type && tsx smart-subscriptions/check.ts && tsx grafast/check.ts && tsx federation/check.ts && tsx prisma/check.ts && tsx prisma/plain-check.ts
scripts.type: tsc -p smart-subscriptions/tsconfig.json && tsc -p grafast/tsconfig.json && tsc -p federation/tsconfig.json && tsc -p prisma/tsconfig.json && tsc -p prisma/tsconfig.plain.json
scripts.generate: prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --script --output prisma/generated/schema.sql
